candidates.angle: topic: gas and DoS on every path
candidates.summary: extends round 1 row 1001 with a stronger consequence: the unsloped msg reaches block scale and free queries; one MsgCall at 92% of MaxBlockMaxGas runs 34.9x the wall time at 64 MiB for a gas ratio of 1.0035, and a free vm/qeval query does the same (35.0x) with msg reaching 768 MiB, past maxAllocTx
candidates.failure_scenario: Deploy a realm whose Burn(n, k) calls bls12381.FastAggregateVerify k times with one valid key, a valid G2 encoding and one n-byte msg. Tx path: one MsgCall BurnTx(64 MiB, 1300) with gas meter MaxBlockMaxGas (tm2/pkg/bft/types/params.go:52, 3_000_000_000) consumes 2782277240 gas, ratio 1.0035 over the 32 B call, and every validator replays it at 34.9x the wall time; per-call work keeps growing to 448 MiB (5.8x over 64 MiB at k=4), so a block-filling tx near maxAllocTx is about 200x by extrapolation, unrun. Query path: vm/qeval and vm/qrender run under maxGasQuery 3_000_000_000 and maxAllocQuery 1_500_000_000 (keeper.go:51-52, :1872-1875) and need no fee; Burn(64 MiB, 1300) completes and Burn(64 MiB, 1500) is out of gas, the same threshold as at 32 B, while the query takes 35.0x the time; Burn(768 MiB, 1) completes, and the dispatcher copies msg into a fresh Go slice outside the allocator (gonative.go:137), so that query holds two 768 MiB copies. The query runs under the mutex every ABCI connection shares (tm2/pkg/bft/proxy/client.go:52 hands &l.mtx to every client; local_client.go:189-191 QuerySync and :173-175 DeliverTxSync lock it), so the serving node's block processing waits for it (read, not run). The tree already guards this class for one native: native_gas_test.go:210 TestInnerHashGasMetersBothOperands pins innerHash's per-byte slope on both operands because its flat charge let 1MiB+1MiB run about 300x over its price.
candidates.verify_by: cp tests/topic2-query-msg_test.go gno.land/pkg/sdk/vm/topic2_query_msg_test.go at fd7e75152 (or 0ee53fefc); cd gno.land && go test -run 'TestTopic2TxBlockGas$' -v -timeout 2m ./pkg/sdk/vm/, then the same with TestTopic2QueryMsg$, TestTopic2TxNearAllocCap$, TestTopic2QueryPastTxAlloc$: expect the gas ratio near 1 and the wall-time ratio far above it
candidates.evidence: TestTopic2TxBlockGas: 'tx msg=32 k=1300: "(1300 int)" gas=2772488179', 'tx msg=67108864 k=1300: "(1300 int)" gas=2782277240', 'gas ratio 64MiB/32B: 1.0035, wall-time ratio: 34.9x'. TestTopic2QueryMsg: 'msg=32B k=1500: out of gas in location: CPUCycles', 'msg=64MiB k=1300: (1300 int)', 'msg=64MiB k=1500: out of gas in location: CPUCycles', 'wall-time ratio of the k=1300 query, 64MiB over 32B: 35.0x'. TestTopic2TxNearAllocCap: 'k=4, 448MiB over 64MiB: gas ratio 3.7623, wall-time ratio 5.8x' (the gas ratio is the msg allocation, charged once per tx). TestTopic2QueryPastTxAlloc: 'msg=768MiB k=1 (maxAllocTx is 500_000_000): (1 int)' PASS. Read: op_call.go:544-545 charge then nativeBody; generated.go:1424-1432 DeepFill and Gno2GoValue per param; gonative.go:137 copy(data, svb.Data[svo:svo+svl]).
